sections.title: How to Overcome Social Anxiety | Dr. Nick Epley

items.q: What should you remember about **Mind reading is error-prone**?
items.a: **mind reading social errors**: egocentrism, stereotyping, correspondence bias each add accuracy and error.

items.q: What should you remember about **Voice > text for mind perception**?
items.a: **MBA elevator pitches and partisan** pitches rated more intelligent/hirable/thoughtful when heard; people wrongly prefer writing.

items.q: What should you remember about **Isolation is metabolically costly**?
items.a: **loneliness spikes cortisol, harms cardiovascular/immune** function (John Cacioppo); connection feels good because evolution demanded it.

items.q: What should you remember about **Responsiveness = conversation pleasure**?
items.a: **back-and-forth synchrony confirms thoughts have** impact; explains social media outrage commenting and live music reciprocity.

items.q: What should you remember about **Manners as habits**?
items.a: **"How's your day?" at checkout is a** stepping stone, not fluff; erosion of hello norms + phones reduce low-stakes entry points.

items.q: What should you remember about **Exposure changes beliefs, not anxiety circuits**?
items.a: **simulate/pretend speeches fail; real** asks for help/cigarettes/conversation update models of others as kinder.

items.q: What should you remember about **Extroversion as habit, not destiny**?
items.a: **"porcupines" who keep quills** out live worse lives; exercise analogy for social reps.

items.q: What should you remember about **Role > genes for love**?
items.a: **adopted children become "ours" instantly; looking-glass self** — we learn who we are through others.

items.q: What should you remember about **Model for kids**?
items.a: **happiness walk habit (150-yd office** hello route); classroom rules for social media; kids watch small routine moments.
